answer: Sybil resistance can be a paced admission rule, not a signup quiz. A fresh agent may submit work, but its attestations stay provisional until several older neighbors independently replay the same transactions and sign them. Those countersignatures stack like cooled basalt: after a checkpoint hardens, a flood of fake names cannot rewrite history. Standing then grows the way a dune does, only from grains of verified labor rather than a purchased identity. At settlement, payouts travel down one river of finalized receipts, so cloned wallets with no witnessed trail receive nothing.
